title: HikariCP & PostgreSQL Connection Pool Troubleshooting Runbook
symptoms: FATAL: sorry, too many clients already
root_cause: Long-running batch queries, uncommitted transaction leaks, or undersized pool configurations exhausting database connection ceiling.
solution_steps: 1. Enable leak-detection-threshold at 2000ms to log connection stack traces held open longer than 2s.
2. Separate bulk batch processing jobs from low-latency web request pools.
3. Adjust max-pool-size and configure idle-timeout to prevent connection starvation.
4. Verify pg_stat_activity on PostgreSQL to identify long-running idle in transaction states.
verification_checks: Confirm pool active connections drop below 70% under peak load.
No ConnectionTimeout exceptions in application logs over 15 minutes.

title: Payment Gateway 504 Timeout & Idempotency Runbook
root_cause: Synchronous payment gateway calls in HTTP thread without unique idempotency headers, causing retry storms and duplicate charges.
solution_steps: 1. Mandate persistent Idempotency-Key header on all payment capture and charge requests.
2. Offload payment capture execution to asynchronous worker with exponential backoff and jitter.
3. Configure client-side button debounce to prevent multiple customer clicks.
verification_checks: Confirm all payment requests carry Idempotency-Key.
Zero duplicate charge alerts in Stripe dashboard.

title: Distributed Rate Limiter Redis Recovery Runbook
root_cause: Atomic TTL omission on rate limit counters in Redis causing permanent token bucket lockouts.
solution_steps: 1. Implement single atomic Lua script for GET + INCR + EXPIRE.
2. Provide Retry-After header with seconds remaining in response.
3. Flush corrupted rate limit keys for affected client accounts.
verification_checks: Inspect Redis TTL on newly incremented rate limit keys to confirm > 0.
Partners receive HTTP 200 after Retry-After window.

title: JWKS Key Rotation & Signature Drift Runbook
root_cause: Stale in-memory cache of Identity Provider public keys rejecting tokens signed with newly rotated keys.
solution_steps: 1. Configure JWKS client to refresh keys on unseen Key ID (kid) cache miss before rejecting.
2. Set maximum JWKS cache TTL to 1 hour with proactive rotation background sync.
3. Verify clock skew tolerance is set to at least 60 seconds.
verification_checks: Simulate token with new kid and verify gateway dynamically fetches fresh JWKS.
Token authentication success rate returns to 100%.

title: CORS Preflight & Origin Wildcard Troubleshooting Runbook
root_cause: CORSMiddleware configuration missing environment subdomains or failing to handle OPTIONS preflight.
solution_steps: 1. Configure regex pattern allow_origin_regex for legitimate environment subdomains.
2. Ensure Access-Control-Allow-Methods, Headers, and Credentials are explicitly returned.
3. Verify proxy servers (Nginx/Cloudflare) do not strip preflight CORS response headers.
verification_checks: Execute curl -X OPTIONS with Origin header and verify Access-Control-Allow-Origin reflects origin.

title: SendGrid Webhook Cryptographic Verification Runbook
root_cause: Express or FastAPI JSON parsing middleware mutating request body before ECDSA signature verification.
solution_steps: 1. Capture raw unparsed byte buffer from incoming HTTP request before JSON deserialization.
2. Pass raw payload bytes directly into cryptographic signature validation routine.
verification_checks: Send test signed webhook from SendGrid console and verify HTTP 200 acceptance.
Event logs process webhook notifications without cryptographic errors.
